findings.title: getSubGroupsCount returns null for a concurrently deleted group, which can still NPE callers
findings.body: When the group is deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() returns null and getSubGroupsCount() now returns null. The declared return type is Long and callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass it straight to representation.setSubGroupCount(...). If that setter takes a primitive long, the unboxing throws an NPE, so the original failure just moves to another place. Other methods in the class (getSubGroupsStream with search or paging) still call modelSupplier.get().xxx() without a null check, so the same race remains there.

findings.title: Test reader thread is not joined and failures there are racy
findings.body: The background reader thread is started but never joined. After deletedAll is set, the main thread asserts on caughtExceptions immediately, so an exception thrown by the reader's final iteration can be missed. This makes the race test flaky, and it can pass without ever reproducing the bug. The thread is also non-daemon. The test calls groups(...) with brief=true, which may not exercise the getSubGroupsCount path that was fixed. Join the thread before asserting.
